title: High protein
summary: 25 to 40 g of protein at every meal, to stay full and keep or build muscle.
description: Protein keeps you fuller for longer, which helps when eating less, and gives your muscles what they need when you train. Sports nutrition research suggests about 1.4 to 2 g of protein per kg of body weight a day for active people, spread over the day at 20 to 40 g per meal. Every meal here gets at least a quarter of its energy from protein.
highlights: 25 to 40 g of protein per meal
Helps keep muscle while losing weight
Pairs well with Pango's training programs
caution: Have kidney disease? Check with your doctor before eating more protein.
